chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, when the stomach is full, it becomes rebellious.

key_terms.إِذَا: When; indicating the condition under which the outcome occurs
key_terms.إِنَّ: Indeed; a particle of emphasis stressing the truth of the statement
key_terms.الْبَطْنَ: The stomach; referring to bodily appetite and consumption

ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام teach about overeating and spiritual discipline?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches moderation in eating and warns that excessive fullness can lead a person toward insolence and loss of self-restraint. It reflects an ethical emphasis on disciplining the nafs and maintaining humility through restraint.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Indeed, when the stomach is full, it becomes rebellious."
